visual.caption: 圖 1｜本課建立的四維攻擊分析框架。
visual.description: 本課的分析工具：目標、管道、冒充身分、要求行動可以同時成立。

items.title: 鎖定誰？｜Target
items.body: 一般員工小林；是否有證據顯示特別針對他設計？

items.title: 從哪裡接觸？｜Channel
items.body: SMS 簡訊與 Voice 語音；同一場攻擊可以跨管道。

items.title: 假扮成誰？｜Identity
items.body: 自稱資訊服務台；假冒可信的客服角色。

items.title: 要求做什麼？｜Action
items.body: 交出登入驗證碼，或核准不是自己發起的登入。

visual.caption: Figure 1 | The four-dimensional analysis framework used in this lesson.
visual.description: A teaching framework: target, channel, claimed identity and requested action can coexist.

items.title: Who is targeted?
items.body: Lin, an ordinary employee. Is there evidence of content tailored to him?

items.title: Which channel?
items.body: SMS and voice. One attack may use more than one channel.

items.title: Who is impersonated?
items.body: The caller claims to be the IT help desk, borrowing trust in that role.

items.title: What is requested?
items.body: Disclose a login code or approve a login the employee did not initiate.

visual.caption: 圖 2｜攻擊者可以同時控制簡訊和電話，製造彼此佐證的假象。
visual.description: 同一個攻擊者安排簡訊與電話，讓小林誤以為兩邊互相佐證。

items.title: 同一個攻擊者
items.body: 同時安排簡訊與語音接觸；控制來源沒有變成兩個。

items.title: 簡訊 SMS
items.body: 攻擊者傳送「帳號出現異常」，引導小林處理假事件。

items.title: 電話 Voice
items.body: 同一方來電自稱資訊客服，提到剛才的簡訊。

items.title: 小林收到兩段接觸
items.body: 一致說法可能只是同源安排，不能單獨證明客服身分。

visual.caption: Figure 2 | One attacker can control both SMS and voice, creating apparent corroboration.
visual.description: One attacker arranges both the text and the call, making them appear to corroborate each other.

items.title: One attacker
items.body: The same source controls both the SMS and the voice contact.

items.title: SMS
items.body: The attacker sends an account-alert text to draw Lin into a fabricated incident.

items.title: Voice call
items.body: The same party claims to be IT support and refers to the earlier text.

items.title: Lin receives both
items.body: Matching claims may share one source; they do not independently verify support.

visual.caption: 圖 3｜一次性驗證碼的社交工程攻擊流程。這是合成情境，並非所有網站都採取相同驗證程序。
visual.description: 合成情境：驗證碼是真的，索取它的人卻可能是假的。每個平台的條件不同。

items.title: 攻擊者發起請求
items.body: 嘗試登入或帳號復原；仍須滿足平台的其他驗證條件。

items.title: 真正的平台發送 OTP
items.body: 平台把該次操作的驗證碼送到小林的手機。

items.title: 小林收到真碼與假電話
items.body: 手機收到真的 OTP；同時有人冒充客服要求念出它。

items.title: 小林把碼交給冒充者
items.body: 驗證碼由持有人轉交給攻擊者，而不是自行在可信入口使用。

items.title: 攻擊者嘗試提交驗證碼
items.body: 把碼送回真正的平台；是否成功仍取決於其他條件與實際紀錄。

visual.caption: Figure 3 | Social engineering around an OTP. This synthetic scenario does not represent every website’s authentication procedure.
visual.description: Synthetic scenario: the code is real, but the person requesting it may be an impostor. Platform rules differ.

items.title: Attacker starts a request
items.body: Attempts login or account recovery; the platform still requires its other conditions.

items.title: Real platform sends the OTP
items.body: The platform sends a code for that operation to Lin's phone.

items.title: Lin receives a real code and a fake call
items.body: A genuine OTP arrives while an impostor claiming to be support asks Lin to read it out.

items.title: Lin discloses the code to the impostor
items.body: The account holder relays the code to the attacker instead of using a trusted entry point.

items.title: Attacker attempts to submit the code
items.body: The code is sent to the real platform. Success depends on other conditions and the actual records.

visual.caption: 圖 4｜抗釣魚能力不等於只是增加一個驗證步驟。
visual.description: 比較的是驗證輸出能否被轉交，以及它是否綁定正確的驗證對象。

items.title: 傳統 OTP
items.body: 本例的簡訊驗證碼有期限、只能使用一次，仍可能被即時轉交給攻擊者。

items.title: 抗釣魚驗證
items.body: 例如正確實作的 FIDO2／WebAuthn 驗證，透過密碼學機制綁定驗證對象。

visual.caption: Figure 4 | Phishing resistance means more than adding another authentication step.
visual.description: Compare whether the authentication output can be relayed and whether it is bound to the intended verifier.

items.title: Traditional OTP
items.body: The SMS code in this example expires and can be used only once, but it may still be relayed to an attacker in real time.

items.title: Phishing-resistant authentication
items.body: Correctly implemented FIDO2/WebAuthn authentication, for example, uses cryptographic mechanisms to bind authentication to the intended verifier.

visual.caption: 圖 5｜獨立查證最重要的是信任來源，不是更換通訊工具。
visual.description: 差別不在換了幾個 App 或問了幾次，而是是否離開可疑來源控制的聯絡方式。

items.title: 路線 A｜仍在可疑來源的圈子
items.body: 可疑簡訊 → 簡訊提供的客服連結 → 對方提供的客服號碼 → 對方聲稱確認成功。這仍沒有獨立證明。

items.title: 路線 B｜回到既有可信程序
items.body: 可疑簡訊 → 暫停、掛斷 → 自行開啟既有服務台 → 核對工單、身分與權限。只執行必要且已授權的操作。

visual.caption: Figure 5 | Independent verification depends on the source of trust, not a change of communication tool.
visual.description: Changing apps or asking again is not enough if the suspicious source supplies every contact detail.

items.title: Path A | Still inside the same source
items.body: Suspicious SMS → support link in that SMS → phone number supplied by that contact → a claim of confirmation. There is still no independent proof.

items.title: Path B | Return to an established process
items.body: Suspicious SMS → pause and hang up → independently open the established help desk → verify the ticket, identity and authority. Perform only needed, authorized actions.

visual.caption: 圖 6｜事件發展與證據層次。實務上各階段可能重疊、跳過或尚無法確認。
visual.description: 這些是不同的證據問題，不是必然依序發生的攻擊階段；可能重疊、跳過或仍無法確認。

items.title: 接觸
items.body: 簡訊與通話紀錄：能證明有接觸跡象，不能單靠顯示資訊確認身分。

items.title: 憑證暴露
items.body: 員工表示說出 OTP：有驗證資訊暴露風險，應立即依風險處置。

items.title: 驗證成功
items.body: 平台驗證或登入紀錄：仍須核對操作者與授權，不能直接認定是攻擊者。

items.title: 未授權操作
items.body: 存取或變更紀錄：核實操作者、工作目的、權限及實際行為。

items.title: 資料外流
items.body: 經核實的傳輸證據：確認資料內容、接收方及範圍，不能只靠下載警示定案。

visual.caption: Figure 6 | Events and evidence levels may overlap, be absent or remain unconfirmed.
visual.description: These are evidence questions, not an inevitable attack sequence. Events may overlap, be absent or remain unconfirmed.

items.title: Contact
items.body: Texts and call records show signs of contact, not necessarily the caller's true identity.

items.title: Credential exposure
items.body: An employee reports sharing an OTP. This creates exposure risk requiring timely protective action.

items.title: Successful authentication
items.body: Platform records still need checks of the operator and authorization; success alone does not identify an attacker.

items.title: Unauthorized action
items.body: Verify the operator, purpose, permissions and actual activity using access or change records.

items.title: Data exfiltration
items.body: Verified transfer evidence must establish content, recipient and scope. A download alert alone is insufficient.

visual.caption: 圖 7｜將 M09-03 放回整體 CEH 的知識架構，而不是單獨背誦三個新名詞。
visual.description: 概念關聯，不是固定攻擊順序。合法授權與交戰規則約束整個測試與調查過程。

items.title: M09｜社交工程
items.body: 辨認釣魚、身分冒充與跨管道信任。

items.title: M02／M04｜偵察與列舉
items.body: 蒐集目標與環境線索；有線索不等於已入侵。

items.title: M01-04／05｜攻擊分析
items.body: 從攻擊向量與實際行為分析；ATT&CK 分類不是成功證明。

items.title: M01-01／02｜安全與風險
items.body: CIA、資產、威脅、弱點與後果。

items.title: M01-06｜防護措施
items.body: 身分驗證、最小權限與縱深防禦。

items.title: M01-07｜事件應變
items.body: 偵測、圍堵、調查、復原與改善。

items.title: M01-03｜合法授權與 ROE
items.body: 安全測試與調查都必須在明確授權與範圍內。

visual.caption: Figure 7 | Connect M09-03 to the wider CEH framework rather than memorizing three isolated terms.
visual.description: Concept relationships, not a fixed attack sequence. Authorization and rules of engagement govern testing and investigation.

items.title: M09 | Social engineering
items.body: Recognize phishing, impersonation and cross-channel trust.

items.title: M02/M04 | Reconnaissance and enumeration
items.body: Gather target and environment clues; clues do not prove compromise.

items.title: M01-04/05 | Attack analysis
items.body: Analyze vectors and observed behavior. An ATT&CK classification is not proof of success.

items.title: M01-01/02 | Security and risk
items.body: CIA, assets, threats, vulnerabilities and consequences.

items.title: M01-06 | Defensive controls
items.body: Authentication, least privilege and defense in depth.

items.title: M01-07 | Incident response
items.body: Detect, contain, investigate, recover and improve.

items.title: M01-03 | Authorization and ROE
items.body: Testing and investigation must stay within explicit permission and scope.
